pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition of adding to positions unless existing trade is floating at minimum +1.5x ATR and stop-loss is locked in guaranteed profit.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require minimum 1.5x ATR (or $2.50 minimum price distance) for stop-loss placement on XAUUSD and reject entries during session roll-over windows (20:00-21:00 UTC).
profit_harvest_threshold: Activate dynamic trailing sentinel at +$5.00 profit to secure 60% of gains while allowing the remaining 40% position to runner up to +$25.00+.
